statements: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jvm_ix_lastActivityAtsessionId_8a35af29 ON jvm_node (JSON_VALUE(props, '$.lastActivityAt'), JSON_VALUE(props, '$.sessionId'))

BEGIN
    MERGE INTO jvm_schema c
    USING (SELECT 'RANGE_INDEX' AS kind, 'Session' AS label, '["lastActivityAt","sessionId"]' AS properties FROM dual) k
    ON (c.kind = k.kind AND c.label = k.label AND c.properties = k.properties)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c.details = '{"labelled": "jvm_lx_SessionlastActivityAtsessionId_396a2573"}'
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (kind, label, properties, name, object_name, details)
        VALUES (k.kind, k.label, k.properties, 'Session_lastActivityAt_sessionId_range', 'jvm_ix_lastActivityAtsessionId_8a35af29', '{"labelled": "jvm_lx_SessionlastActivityAtsessionId_396a2573"}');
EXCEPTION WHEN DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX THEN
    -- Another process recorded it between the MERGE's read and its insert: it is recorded.
    NULL;
END;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jvm_v_Chunkembedding_7e60bd64 (nid NUMBER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES jvm_node (nid) ON DELETE CASCADE, embedding VECTOR(2, FLOAT32) NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO jvm_v_Chunkembedding_7e60bd64 (nid, embedding)
SELECT n.nid, TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(n.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB)) FROM jvm_node n
WHERE INSTR(JSON_SERIALIZE(n.labels), '"Chunk"') > 0 AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.embedding') AND VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(n.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB))) = 2
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jvm_v_Chunkembedding_7e60bd64 s WHERE s.nid = n.nid)
CREATE VECTOR INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jvm_v_Chunkembedding_7e60bd64_i ON jvm_v_Chunkembedding_7e60bd64 (embedding) ORGANIZATION NEIGHBOR PARTITIONS DISTANCE COSINE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jvm_ix_uuid_36f3bb ON jvm_node (JSON_VALUE(props, '$.uuid'))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jvm_uq_Personuuid_44d1cd66 ON jvm_node n (CASE WHEN JSON_EXISTS(n.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Person")') AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.uuid') THEN JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$.uuid') END)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jvm_uq_Personemailtenant_83779439 ON jvm_node n (CASE WHEN JSON_EXISTS(n.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Person")') AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.email') AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.tenant') THEN JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$.email') END, CASE WHEN JSON_EXISTS(n.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Person")') AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.email') AND JSON_EXISTS(n.props, '$.tenant') THEN JSON_VALUE(n.props, '$.tenant') END)
